content.text: I think there are some issues with the axes ranges on a multi-component animation. Each sub-figure should have adapted ranges to each component. So if you load a dataset with 4 components, then the axes ranges should be set in each of the subfigures by the data in that subfigure
I’ll trace how animations set subplot ranges and make each component use its own data bounds. I’m using the design, architecture, development, and testing skills for this fix.

I found the cause: the animation combines all components into one value range and applies it to every subplot. I’ll give each panel its own range across the animation, while keeping explicit limits and per-frame rescaling working.

The fix needs matching support in the plotting backend so each panel can receive its bounds before drawing. I also found that transposed line plots share the value axis; I’ll correct that so their component ranges can stay independent. I’m using the API/CLI and data skills for these changes.
